incidents.name: Deprecation notice: SPV asset naming update on Spot REST API

incident_updates.body: This incident has been resolved.

The Assets and AssetPairs endpoints now accept an optional include_spv parameter. Set include_spv=false to leave the SPV entries of tokenized assets (for example AAPLSPV and AAPLSPVUSD) out of full listings. The default is true, so existing responses don’t change. If you only use the rebased x entries (AAPLx, AAPLxUSD), you can pass include_spv=false instead of updating your mapping for the 24 November SPV name change.

The legacy rebased x names previously returned for SPV entries in Assets and AssetPairs are deprecated. These entries now return SPV asset and pair names. If your integration identifies SPV entries using altname, wsname, or base, please update its mappings. The rebased x entries remain unchanged.

Change details: https://docs.kraken.com/exchange/changelog#24-november-2026-%E2%80%94-spot-rest-v1
